reviewer_notes: No special-education pay differential exists in this contract. Searched 'special education', 'sped', 'stipend', 'differential', 'additional compensation', 'extra pay', 'caseload', 'shortage', 'hard-to-staff', 'bonus', 'IEP/autism/disabilities', 'endorsement/certification', 'speech', 'nurse', 'job share' across all 55 pages plus Appendices A-M; the only sped mentions are the elementary-specialist list (PDF pp.21-22), the case-manager caseload study committee with no pay (PDF p.22), the Special Education Joint Committee (Appendix K, PDF p.52), and a Master's qualification list (PDF p.24). Appendix B's index add-ons (Title I Supervisor, Mentors, BLIC, Elementary Teaching Assistant Principals, Elementary Reading Supervisors, PE Coordinator, ELL Coordinator) include no sped role. B's quote is verbatim and does sit on PDF page 21, but it is only the definitional list for Article XII C.5 prep time; the operative clause ('Any elementary specialist who receives less than 5 (30 minute) preps per week will be compensated for each missed prep', PDF p.21, confirmed by Appendix L, PDF p.53) is missed-prep compensation available to all elementary specialists including art, music, PE, health and guidance, not a special-education role differential, so it does not support 'yes' under the codebook's role-differential instruction.
